lessons_used: Reordering the onboarding flow (moving sign-in after adoption selection) was helpful (+5.5%), though the +10.0% prediction was over-optimistic.
Updating intro copy (desktop spawning instructions) showed no clear effect (-0.6%), and the +12.0% prediction was far too high.
Adding progress indicators and tip carousels to the waiting screen showed no clear effect, despite leaning positive (+4.0%, p=0.051).
Layout tweaks (centered mascot intro) provided no benefit (+0.1%) and triggered guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions across all rounds were consistently too high compared to measured results.

lessons_next: Reordering the onboarding flow (moving sign-in after adoption selection) was helpful (+5.5%).
Adding desktop ready background notification prompts was helpful (+5.1%).
Copy updates and quick hints (spawning instructions, account recovery warnings, overlay hints) showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen updates (progress indicators and tip carousels) showed no clear effect.

Predictions were mostly over-optimistic, though the notification prompt was slightly under-predicted (+4.0% vs +5.1%).
